notes: Actual results for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025, as the county reported them in its Annual Financial Report to the Iowa Department of Management. Not a budget.
Public schools are run by separate school districts with their own taxes, so they are not included.
Spending is reported by service area. Capital projects have no service area, so they are spread over the county's other spending in proportion.
Borrowing, transfers between funds, refunded debt and sales of capital assets are left out.
Administration and government services to residents (recorder, treasurer, elections) count as overhead.
Debt outstanding is not in the Department of Management's published data, so no debt figure is given and debt is not scored.
Political money is not scored: contributions to Iowa county candidates were not loaded.
Transparency practices have not been checked yet, so they are not scored.

notes: Actual results for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025, as the city reported them in its Annual Financial Report to the Iowa Department of Management. Not a budget.
Public schools are run by separate school districts with their own taxes, so they are not included. Residents also pay Chickasaw County.

Spending is reported by program for every fund, enterprise funds included. Capital projects have no program, so they are spread over the city's other spending in proportion; enterprise capital outlay counts as utilities.
Borrowing, transfers between funds, internal TIF loans and sales of capital assets are left out.
General government and community and economic development (including TIF rebates to developers) count as overhead.
Debt outstanding is not in the Department of Management's published data, so no debt figure is given and debt is not scored.
Political money is not scored: contributions to Iowa city candidates were not loaded.
Transparency practices have not been checked yet, so they are not scored.
Cameras: no license-plate cameras are mapped inside City of North Washington's borders in OpenStreetMap as of 2026-10-18.
